package consumer_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/zhoushoujianwork/offload/pkg/execution"
)

const codexReply = `printf '%s\n' '{"type":"thread.started","thread_id":"native-1"}'
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"m","type":"agent_message","text":"library answer"}}'
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"turn.completed","usage":{"input_tokens":12,"output_tokens":3}}'
`

var (
	_ = execution.NewEnvironmentAt
	_ = execution.NativeControls{CodexAppServer: true, SkillRoots: []string{"/approved"}}
	_ = execution.RawEvent{NativeProtocol: "codex-app-server"}
	_ = execution.Result{NativeProtocol: "codex-app-server"}
)

func fixture(t *testing.T, backend, body string) (*execution.Client, string, string) {
	t.Helper()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(dir, "config"))
	t.Setenv("XDG_STATE_HOME", filepath.Join(dir, "state"))
	t.Setenv("CODEX_HOME", filepath.Join(dir, "codex"))
	t.Setenv("OFFLOAD_MAX_WORKERS", "-1")
	args := filepath.Join(dir, "args")
	bin := filepath.Join(dir, "native")
	script := "#!/bin/sh\nprintf x >> '" + args + ".calls'\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$@\" > '" + args + "'\n"
	if backend == "codex" {
		script += "cat > '" + args + ".stdin'\n"
	} else {
		script += "(while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case \"$1\" in --append-system-prompt-file) cp \"$2\" '" + args + ".instructions';; esac; shift; done)\n"
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(bin, []byte(script+body), 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Setenv("OFFLOAD_CODEX", bin)
	t.Setenv("OFFLOAD_CLAUDE", bin)
	p := execution.Profile{Backend: backend, Model: "fixture-model"}
	if backend == "claude" {
		srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) {}))
		t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
		p.BaseURL, p.Token = srv.URL, "fixture-token"
	}
	client, err := execution.New(execution.Config{ProfileName: "fixture", Profile: p})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return client, dir, args
}

func read(t *testing.T, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(name)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

func TestCodexFreshResumeAndPrivateEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	c, dir, args := fixture(t, "codex", codexReply)
	extra := t.TempDir()
	var events []execution.RawEvent
	req := execution.Request{Task: "visible task", Directory: dir, Caller: "agh", CallerRunID: "agh:task-1",
		Instructions: []byte("internal context"), AdditionalDirectories: []string{extra},
		OnEvent: func(e execution.RawEvent) error { events = append(events, e); return nil }}
	r, err := c.Run(context.Background(), req)
	if err != nil || r.Status != "ok" || r.Report != "library answer" || r.NativeSessionID != "native-1" || r.RunID == "" || r.ExitCode != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	if len(events) != 3 || events[0].RunID != r.RunID || events[0].CallerRunID != req.CallerRunID || events[0].Backend != "codex" {
		t.Fatalf("events %+v", events)
	}
	var record map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal(r.RawRecord, &record) != nil || record["task"] != req.Task || record["caller"] != "agh" || record["caller_run_id"] != req.CallerRunID {
		t.Fatalf("record %s", r.RawRecord)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(read(t, args+".stdin"), "internal context") || strings.Contains(read(t, args), "internal context") || !strings.Contains(read(t, args), extra) {
		t.Fatal("instructions/directory transport changed")
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "state", "offload", "runs.jsonl")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatal("library wrote CLI history")
	}
	req.NativeSessionID, req.Task = r.NativeSessionID, "continue"
	second, err := c.Run(context.Background(), req)
	if err != nil || second.RunID == r.RunID || second.NativeSessionID != r.NativeSessionID || !strings.Contains(read(t, args), "resume\n") {
		t.Fatalf("resume %+v %v", second, err)
	}
}

func TestOptInHistoryTerminalOutcomes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scenario := range []string{"success", "failure", "canceled", "timeout", "setup-canceled"} {
		t.Run(scenario, func(t *testing.T) {
			body := codexReply
			if scenario == "failure" {
				body = "exit 7\n"
			} else if scenario == "canceled" || scenario == "timeout" {
				body = `printf '%s\n' '{"type":"thread.started","thread_id":"native-1"}'; exec sleep 60` + "\n"
			}
			c, dir, _ := fixture(t, "codex", body)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			req := execution.Request{Task: "history fixture", Directory: dir, Caller: "agh", CallerRunID: "agh:history", RecordHistory: true}
			if scenario == "canceled" {
				req.OnEvent = func(execution.RawEvent) error { cancel(); return nil }
			} else if scenario == "timeout" {
				limit := time.Second
				req.Timeout = &limit
			} else if scenario == "setup-canceled" {
				cancel()
			}
			r, err := c.Run(ctx, req)
			if (scenario == "success") != (err == nil) || !r.HistoryRecorded || r.HistoryError != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
			}
			if strings.Contains(scenario, "canceled") && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if scenario == "timeout" && !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(read(t, filepath.Join(dir, "state", "offload", "runs.jsonl"))), "\n")
			if len(lines) != 1 || lines[0] != string(r.RawRecord) {
				t.Fatalf("history must contain exactly the returned native record: %v %s", lines, r.RawRecord)
			}
			var record map[string]any
			if json.Unmarshal([]byte(lines[0]), &record) != nil || record["run_id"] != r.RunID || record["caller_run_id"] != req.CallerRunID || record["status"] != r.Status {
				t.Fatalf("correlation/outcome lost: %s", lines[0])
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestHistoryFailurePreservesExecutionAndDoesNotRetry(t *testing.T) {
	for _, failure := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "success", true: "failure"}[failure], func(t *testing.T) {
			body := codexReply
			if failure {
				body = "exit 7\n"
			}
			c, dir, args := fixture(t, "codex", body)
			// A directory at the log path fails even when tests run as root.
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(dir, "state", "offload", "runs.jsonl"), 0700); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			r, err := c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir, RecordHistory: true})
			if r.HistoryRecorded || r.HistoryError == nil || len(r.RawRecord) == 0 || (err != nil) != failure {
				t.Fatalf("history failure changed execution: %+v %v", r, err)
			}
			if !failure && (r.Status != "ok" || r.Report != "library answer" || r.ExitCode != 0) {
				t.Fatalf("%+v", r)
			}
			if calls := read(t, args+".calls"); calls != "x" {
				t.Fatalf("native invocation repeated: %q", calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestClaudeToolControlsAndInstructions(t *testing.T) {
	body := `printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","is_error":false,"result":"claude answer","session_id":"claude-1","num_turns":1}'` + "\n"
	c, dir, args := fixture(t, "claude", body)
	r, err := c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir, AllowedTools: "Read,Grep", DisallowedTools: "Bash", Instructions: []byte("host context")})
	if err != nil || r.Report != "claude answer" || r.NativeSessionID != "claude-1" {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	flags := read(t, args)
	if !strings.Contains(flags, "--allowedTools\nRead Grep\n") || !strings.Contains(flags, "--disallowedTools\nBash\n") || strings.Contains(flags, "--dangerously-skip-permissions") || !strings.Contains(read(t, args+".instructions"), "host context") {
		t.Fatal(flags)
	}
}

func TestHostNativeControlsUseSharedWorkerAndCallerHistory(t *testing.T) {
	body := `d="$(dirname "$0")"
cat > "$d/args.stdin"
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","is_error":false,"result":"host answer","session_id":"claude-host","structured_output":{"ok":true}}'
`
	c, dir, args := fixture(t, "claude", body)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "AGENTS.md"), []byte("ambient project instructions must not be added"), 0600)
	req := execution.Request{Caller: "agh", CallerRunID: "agh:business-1", Task: "visible user task", Directory: dir,
		Instructions: []byte("Host instructions only"), RecordHistory: true,
		Native: &execution.NativeControls{CallerContext: true, Executable: filepath.Join(dir, "native"),
			ProfileDirectory: filepath.Join(dir, "native-profile"), FreshSessionID: "claude-host",
			PermissionMode: "bypassPermissions", AllowedTools: []string{"Read", "mcp__history__read"},
			MCPServers: []execution.MCPServer{{Name: "history", Command: "/bin/echo", Args: []string{"capability"}}},
			JSONSchema: `{"type":"object"}`, SkillDirectory: filepath.Join(dir, "skills")}}
	t.Setenv("OFFLOAD_CLAUDE", filepath.Join(dir, "must-not-run"))
	r, err := c.Run(context.Background(), req)
	if err != nil || r.Status != "ok" || !r.HistoryRecorded || r.NativeSessionID != "claude-host" || string(r.StructuredOutput) != `{"ok":true}` {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	flags := read(t, args)
	for _, value := range []string{"--session-id\nclaude-host\n", "--permission-mode\nbypassPermissions\n", "--plugin-dir\n", "--json-schema\n", "--strict-mcp-config\n", `"history"`, `"command":"/bin/echo"`} {
		if !strings.Contains(flags, value) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s: %s", value, flags)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(flags, req.Task) || strings.Contains(flags, string(req.Instructions)) || read(t, args+".instructions") != string(req.Instructions) || read(t, args+".stdin") != req.Task {
		t.Fatal("Host task/context transport changed")
	}
	var record map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal(r.RawRecord, &record) != nil || record["caller"] != "agh" || record["caller_run_id"] != req.CallerRunID || record["task"] != req.Task {
		t.Fatalf("caller correlation lost: %s", r.RawRecord)
	}
}

func TestHostNativeControlsRejectUnsupportedBackendBeforeLaunch(t *testing.T) {
	c, dir, args := fixture(t, "codex", codexReply)
	r, err := c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir, Native: &execution.NativeControls{CallerContext: true}})
	var re *execution.RunError
	if !errors.As(err, &re) || re.Kind != "unsupported_controls" || r.Status != "error" {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(args + ".calls"); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatal("unsupported control launched a backend")
	}
}

func TestHostExtractionIsFreshToolFreeAndNonpersistent(t *testing.T) {
	c, dir, args := fixture(t, "claude", `printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","is_error":false,"result":"","session_id":"extract-1","structured_output":{"items":[]}}'`+"\n")
	r, err := c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{Caller: "agh", CallerRunID: "agh:extract:1", Task: "extract fixture", Directory: dir, ToolsDisabled: true,
		Native: &execution.NativeControls{CallerContext: true, Extraction: true, FreshSessionID: "extract-1", JSONSchema: `{"type":"object"}`}})
	if err != nil || string(r.StructuredOutput) != `{"items":[]}` {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	flags := read(t, args)
	for _, value := range []string{"--tools\n\n", "--safe-mode\n", "--no-session-persistence\n", "--system-prompt\n", "disableAllHooks"} {
		if !strings.Contains(flags, value) {
			t.Fatal(flags)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(flags, "--dangerously-skip-permissions") {
		t.Fatal("extraction inherited business approval bypass")
	}
}

func TestUnsupportedControlsAndPreCanceledDoNotLaunch(t *testing.T) {
	c, dir, args := fixture(t, "codex", codexReply)
	r, err := c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir, ToolsDisabled: true})
	var re *execution.RunError
	if !errors.As(err, &re) || re.Kind != "unsupported_tools" || r.Status != "error" {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(args); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatal("unsupported policy started native backend")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	_, err = c.Run(ctx, execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir})
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(args); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatal("canceled request started native backend")
	}
	ctx2, stop := context.WithCancelCause(context.Background())
	cause := errors.New("host stopped")
	stop(cause)
	_, err = c.Run(ctx2, execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir})
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || !errors.Is(err, cause) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestCancellationAndConcurrentRunIsolation(t *testing.T) {
	body := `printf '{"type":"thread.started","thread_id":"native-%s"}\n' "$$"
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"m","type":"agent_message","text":"done"}}'
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"turn.completed","usage":{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":1}}'
`
	c, dir, _ := fixture(t, "codex", body)
	t.Setenv("OFFLOAD_MAX_WORKERS", "2")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	started := make(chan struct{}, 2)
	release := make(chan struct{})
	defer func() {
		select {
		case <-release:
		default:
			close(release)
		}
	}()
	observe := func(e execution.RawEvent) error {
		if strings.Contains(string(e.Data), "thread.started") {
			started <- struct{}{}
			<-release
		}
		return nil
	}
	type outcome struct {
		result execution.Result
		err    error
	}
	first, second := make(chan outcome, 1), make(chan outcome, 1)
	go func() {
		r, e := c.Run(ctx, execution.Request{RunID: "concurrent-a", Task: "a", Directory: dir, OnEvent: observe, RecordHistory: true})
		first <- outcome{r, e}
	}()
	go func() {
		r, e := c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{RunID: "concurrent-b", Task: "b", Directory: dir, OnEvent: observe, RecordHistory: true})
		second <- outcome{r, e}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		select {
		case <-started:
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("independent calls did not both start")
		}
	}
	files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "state", "offload", "live", "*.json"))
	if err != nil || len(files) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("live records %v %v", files, err)
	}
	ids := map[string]bool{}
	for _, f := range files {
		var s struct {
			RunID string `json:"run_id"`
		}
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(read(t, f)), &s) != nil {
			t.Fatal(f)
		}
		ids[s.RunID] = true
	}
	if !ids["concurrent-a"] || !ids["concurrent-b"] {
		t.Fatal(ids)
	}
	if _, err := c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{RunID: "concurrent-a", Task: "duplicate", Directory: dir}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate active execution ID was allowed to overwrite evidence")
	}
	cancel()
	close(release)
	select {
	case a := <-first:
		if !errors.Is(a.err, context.Canceled) || a.result.ErrorKind != "canceled" {
			t.Fatalf("canceled %+v %v", a.result, a.err)
		}
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cancellation cleanup timed out")
	}
	select {
	case b := <-second:
		if b.err != nil || b.result.Status != "ok" {
			t.Fatalf("other call affected %+v %v", b.result, b.err)
		}
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("other call did not complete")
	}
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(read(t, filepath.Join(dir, "state", "offload", "runs.jsonl"))), "\n")
	if len(lines) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("concurrent history count: %d", len(lines))
	}
	ids = map[string]bool{}
	for _, line := range lines {
		var record map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ids[record["run_id"].(string)] = true
	}
	if !ids["concurrent-a"] || !ids["concurrent-b"] {
		t.Fatal(ids)
	}
}

func TestDeadlineAndObserverFailureRetainCauses(t *testing.T) {
	c, dir, args := fixture(t, "codex", `printf '%s\n' '{"type":"thread.started","thread_id":"native-1"}'; exec sleep 60`+"\n")
	launches := func() int { b, _ := os.ReadFile(args + ".calls"); return len(b) }
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	r, err := c.Run(ctx, execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir})
	if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || r.Status != "timeout" {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	firstCalls := launches()
	if firstCalls > 1 {
		t.Fatal("deadline invocation repeated native execution")
	}
	limit := time.Second
	r, err = c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir, Timeout: &limit})
	if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || r.Status != "timeout" {
		t.Fatalf("native timeout %+v %v", r, err)
	}
	secondCalls := launches()
	if secondCalls-firstCalls > 1 {
		t.Fatal("native timeout repeated native execution")
	}
	boom := errors.New("observer unavailable")
	r, err = c.Run(context.Background(), execution.Request{Task: "inspect", Directory: dir, OnEvent: func(execution.RawEvent) error { return boom }})
	if !errors.Is(err, boom) || r.Status == "ok" || r.ErrorKind != "events_io" {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", r, err)
	}
	if calls := launches(); calls-secondCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("observer failure did not run exactly one native invocation: %d", calls-secondCalls)
	}
}

func TestLoadConfigExplicitSelectionAndValidation(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "config.json")
	os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`{"default":"other","profiles":{"chosen":{"backend":"codex","aliases":["alias"],"model":"fixture"}}}`), 0600)
	t.Setenv("OFFLOAD_PROFILE", "other")
	cfg, err := execution.LoadConfig(path, "alias")
	if err != nil || cfg.ProfileName != "chosen" || cfg.Profile.Model != "fixture" {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", cfg, err)
	}
	if _, err := execution.LoadConfig(path, ""); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("implicit profile accepted")
	}
	if _, err := execution.LoadConfig("relative", "chosen"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("relative config accepted")
	}
	if _, err := execution.New(execution.Config{}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("implicit client config accepted")
	}
}

func TestHostNativeExitAndOriginalCause(t *testing.T) {
 c,dir,_ := fixture(t,"claude","echo private-diagnostic >&2\nexit 7\n")
 r,err := c.Run(context.Background(),execution.Request{Caller:"agh",Task:"inspect",Directory:dir,Native:&execution.NativeControls{CallerContext:true}})
 var exit *exec.ExitError
 if !errors.As(err,&exit) || exit.ExitCode()!=7 || r.NativeExitCode==nil || *r.NativeExitCode!=7 || !strings.Contains(r.NativeStderr,"private-diagnostic") { t.Fatalf("%+v %v",r,err) }
}

func TestMonitorStopKeepsHostAndSiblingAlive(t *testing.T) {
 body := `printf '{"type":"thread.started","thread_id":"native-%s"}\n' "$$"
sleep 2
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"m","type":"agent_message","text":"done"}}'
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"turn.completed","usage":{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":1}}'
`
 c,dir,_:=fixture(t,"codex",body)
 t.Setenv("OFFLOAD_MAX_WORKERS","2")
 type outcome struct { r execution.Result; err error }
 first,second:=make(chan outcome,1),make(chan outcome,1)
 started:=make(chan string,2)
 observe:=func(e execution.RawEvent)error{ if strings.Contains(string(e.Data),"thread.started"){started<-e.RunID};return nil }
 ids:=[]string{strings.Repeat("a",32),strings.Repeat("b",32)}
 for i,ch:=range []chan outcome{first,second}{ go func(id string,out chan outcome){r,err:=c.Run(context.Background(),execution.Request{RunID:id,Caller:"agh",Task:"monitor fixture",Directory:dir,RecordHistory:true,Monitor:&execution.MonitorOptions{CaptureTranscript:true},OnEvent:observe});out<-outcome{r,err}}(ids[i],ch) }
 for i:=0;i<2;i++{select{case <-started:case <-time.After(10*time.Second):t.Fatal("no native registration")}}
 var manifest struct{Address,Token string}
 raw:=read(t,filepath.Join(dir,"state","offload","controls",ids[0]+".json"))
 if json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw),&manifest)!=nil{t.Fatal("invalid control manifest")}
 q,_:=http.NewRequest("POST","http://"+manifest.Address+"/stop",nil);q.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer "+manifest.Token)
 response,err:=http.DefaultClient.Do(q);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};response.Body.Close()
 if response.StatusCode!=200{t.Fatal(response.StatusCode)}
 select{case out:=<-first:if !errors.Is(out.err,context.Canceled)||out.r.MonitorError!=nil||!out.r.HistoryRecorded{t.Fatalf("%+v %v",out.r,out.err)};case <-time.After(10*time.Second):t.Fatal("stop did not clean up")}
 select{case out:=<-second:if out.err!=nil||out.r.Status!="ok"{t.Fatalf("sibling affected %+v %v",out.r,out.err)};case <-time.After(10*time.Second):t.Fatal("sibling stopped")}
 capture:=read(t,filepath.Join(dir,"state","offload","transcripts",ids[0]+".ndjson"))
 if !strings.Contains(capture,"execution_end")||!strings.Contains(capture,"canceled"){t.Fatal("canceled evidence lost")}
}
